opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, based in a UK university or not-for-profit research organisation; up to two co-applicants from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards crossing science, engineering, and the social sciences/humanities, in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call, across all career stages; some prior public engagement experience expected; previous recipients not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with humanities and social sciences research, in partnership with a GLAM organisation or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: Symposium covers travel, accommodation and visa costs; seed funding available for international collaborations

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together early-career researchers from the UK and Germany to discuss interdisciplinary themes and form collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: Three-year award under FEC; Academy funds 80% of salary, directly allocated and indirect costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation; viva completed between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; no permanent academic post held.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers to pursue an independent research project towards a significant piece of publishable research, supported by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences, ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills (e.g. quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods and interdisciplinary approaches.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: PI must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, of postdoctoral or above status, with overseas co-applicants; must demonstrate genuine interdisciplinarity.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research projects led by and grounded in the humanities and/or social sciences on the theme of 'Mobilities', collaborating across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for early- and mid-career SHAPE researchers to embed themselves in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, developing skills and policy-relevant analysis across areas such as security, Indo-European relations, technology/AI and European strategy-making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders, or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months, who require additional support.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs (e.g. specific equipment, assistance for sensory impairments, caring costs, application support) for applicants and award-holders, in addition to research expenses.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral scholars (or equivalent) ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom; independent scholars eligible; co-applicants may be from anywhere in the world.
opportunities.summary: Small research grants (up to £10,000, tenable up to 24 months) to cover expenses arising from a defined research project in the humanities and social sciences.
